item.title: Tigers crown 3 National Champions, haul All-American honors at NCCAA Championships
item.description: CEDARVILLE, Ohio. — The Campbellsville University Track & Field teams delivered a definitive performance at the NCCAA Indoor National Championships this weekend, bringing home three national titles, a sweeping collection of All-American honors, and multiple podium finishes on the national stage. The men's squad produced two national champions and finished sixth overall, while the women's team capitalized on every opportunity to secure a fourth-place team finish.

item.title: Carr and Young claim MSC titles as Tigers earn top-four team finishes
item.description: LOUISVILLE, Ky. — The Campbellsville University Track & Field teams made a statement Tuesday at the Mid-South Conference Indoor Championships, claiming individual titles and storming to a third-place finish on the men's side and a fourth-place showing for the women.

item.title: Tait leaps to #9, Lady Tigers tied for #17 in final NAIA Poll
item.description: KANSAS CITY, Mo. – The National Association of Intercollegiate Athletics (NAIA) released the Final Women's Wrestling Coaches' Top 20 Poll of the 2025-26 season on Wednesday. Following a weekend that saw three podium finishes at the Blue Raider Open, the Campbellsville University women's wrestling team checks in tied for #17, accumulating 53 points in the national rating.

item.title: Bradley’s 24 points, stifling second-half defense lift #5 Lady Tigers past #21 Cumberlands, 74-71
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The #5 Campbellsville University Lady Tigers hosted the #21 University of the Cumberlands Patriots on Thursday at the Powell Athletic Center for their final regular-season home matchup. Overcoming a double-digit early deficit and capitalizing on 19 Cumberlands turnovers, Campbellsville secured a dramatic 74-71 conference victory on Senior Night.

item.title: Milburn reaches 1,000 career points as Tigers fall to #17 Cumberlands, 76-66
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. – The Campbellsville University men's basketball team hosted the #17 University of the Cumberlands Patriots on Thursday night for their regular-season home finale. Despite four Tigers scoring in double figures and a historic milestone for senior Jay Milburn, Campbellsville was unable to defeat the Patriots, falling 76-66.

item.title: Flag Football primed to build on historic momentum in 2026 season
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. — The (RV) Campbellsville University Women's Flag Football team is set to launch its fourth season, stepping onto the gridiron with historic momentum and a new era of leadership.

item.title: #5 Tigers sweep IU East, set program record with 13-0 start
item.description: CAMPBELLSVILLE, Ky. — The #5 Campbellsville University men's volleyball team hosted the Indiana University East Red Wolves on Friday night to officially open conference play. With a clean 3-0 sweep (25-21, 25-19, 25-18) over IU East, the Tigers improved to 13-0, surpassing the 2020 squad to record the best undefeated start in program history.
